title: 13 Best Coffee Shops in Da Nang
description: The best coffee shops and cafes in Da Nang, Vietnam — curated from Reddit & coffee blogs. Specialty roasters, traditional cà phê phin, salt coffee & laptop-friendly spots.

places.name: XLIII Specialty Coffee
places.address: Lô 419, 422 Ngô Thì Sĩ, Bắc Mỹ An

redditQuotes.text: XLIII definitely lived up to the hype... they only serve their pourovers, hot. Bonus point for the cardamom sourdough.
redditQuotes.source: — r/CoffeePH · Da Nang and Hoi An Coffee Crawl

redditQuotes.text: XLIII takes specialty coffee seriously — perhaps more seriously than anywhere else in Da Nang. Five years of operation have established their reputation for uncompromising quality.
redditQuotes.source: — The Way to Coffee · Da Nang Specialty Guide

places.verdict: Da Nang's most serious specialty coffee — five years of uncompromising quality that puts beans before vibes.

comparison.best for: Serious coffee lovers who want the best cup in Da Nang
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 8,591 Google reviews · Uncompromising bean quality · Knowledgeable baristas
comparison.limitations: Higher prices (₫60k–₫150k) · Minimal Vietnamese beans — barista says none meet their standard yet
comparison.price / value: ₫60,000–₫150,000 · Premium but worth it for specialty
comparison.what to order: Pour-over with their current single-origin rotation. The cardamom sourdough pairs perfectly. Ask the barista about processing methods — they love to geek out.

places.whatToOrder: Pour-over with their current single-origin rotation. The cardamom sourdough pairs perfectly. Ask the barista about processing methods — they love to geek out.
places.editorialSummary: Da Nang's most serious specialty coffee — five years of uncompromising quality that puts beans before vibes.
places.bestFor: Serious coffee lovers who want the best cup in Da Nang

places.name: O2o First Roast

redditQuotes.text: o2o First Roast was a pleasant surprise... served my pourover 3 ways, hot, iced and w/ lemon cheong.
redditQuotes.source: — r/CoffeePH · Da Nang and Hoi An Coffee Crawl

redditQuotes.text: It feels like a speakeasy bar... what it lacks in impression it makes up for in great coffee. I found my cold brew with lemon to be exceptional.
redditQuotes.source: — Sprudge · The Sprudge Guide to Coffee in Da Nang

places.verdict: A speakeasy-style hidden gem with the highest Google rating in Da Nang (4.9★). The owner is an anime fan who themes coffee profiles around Japanese animation.

comparison.best for: Adventurous coffee drinkers who want a unique, intimate experience
comparison.strengths: 4.9★ rating · Rotating single-origin Ethiopian beans · Cold brew with lemon is exceptional · Anime-themed tasting notes
comparison.limitations: Easy to walk past — hidden in a residential side street · Small space · Not Instagrammable from outside
comparison.what to order: Cold brew with lemon — slightly acidic with hints of floral, orange, and raspberry. Or try the matcha with lemon and gin for something wild.

places.whatToOrder: Cold brew with lemon — slightly acidic with hints of floral, orange, and raspberry. Or try the matcha with lemon and gin for something wild.

places.name: SẾU The Tearoom

redditQuotes.text: After five years running a coffee stand, Vinh and his wife opened SẾU to create something more permanent and contemplative. The Japanese influence shows immediately.
redditQuotes.source: — The Way to Coffee · Da Nang Specialty Guide

places.verdict: A serene Japanese-influenced space where five years of running a coffee stand evolved into something contemplative and permanent.

comparison.best for: Matcha lovers and anyone seeking a calm, meditative cafe experience
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ · Japanese-influenced design · Both matcha and specialty coffee done well · Contemplative atmosphere
comparison.limitations: More tea-focused than coffee · Slightly higher prices
comparison.what to order: Their signature matcha if you're a tea person, or the specialty coffee if you want to see how Japanese brewing precision meets Vietnamese beans.

places.whatToOrder: Their signature matcha if you're a tea person, or the specialty coffee if you want to see how Japanese brewing precision meets Vietnamese beans.

places.name: Indigo Coffee
places.address: 30 Bạch Đằng, Thạch Thang, Hải Châu

redditQuotes.text: Not many tourists who visit Da Nang make it to the Hải Châu District, but this part of the city is worth visiting. A couple of blocks from the riverfront, you'll find Indigo.
redditQuotes.source: — Sprudge · The Sprudge Guide to Coffee in Da Nang

places.verdict: Worth crossing the Han River for — a specialty cafe in the less-touristed Hải Châu district that rewards the adventurous.

comparison.best for: Coffee lovers exploring beyond the tourist beach strip
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ · Hai Chau riverside location · Away from tourist crowds · Quality beans
comparison.limitations: Requires crossing one of Da Nang's bridges · Less walkable from beach hotels
comparison.what to order: Ask the barista for their current specialty pour-over. Pair it with exploring the Hải Châu district's morning bò né (sizzling steak) breakfast spots nearby.

places.whatToOrder: Ask the barista for their current specialty pour-over. Pair it with exploring the Hải Châu district's morning bò né (sizzling steak) breakfast spots nearby.
places.editorialSummary: Worth crossing the Han River for — a specialty cafe in the less-touristed Hải Châu district that rewards the adventurous.
places.bestFor: Coffee lovers exploring beyond the tourist beach strip

places.name: NAM House Cafe

redditQuotes.text: This was probably my favorite coffee shop in Danang. Nam House feels like a time capsule. Not only great coffee at reasonable prices, but I loved the atmosphere.

places.verdict: A vintage time capsule that feels like stepping into 1970s Vietnam — antiques, nostalgia, and genuinely great traditional coffee at budget prices.

comparison.best for: Atmosphere seekers, Instagram photographers, traditional coffee lovers
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 1,760 reviews · Stunning vintage decor · Budget-friendly (₫25k–₫60k) · Great cà phê muối
comparison.limitations: Can get crowded with Instagrammers · Traditional coffee only (not specialty)
comparison.what to order: Cà phê muối (salt coffee) — served in a beautiful vintage setting, it tastes even better. Head to the second floor for the best photo backdrop.

places.whatToOrder: Cà phê muối (salt coffee) — served in a beautiful vintage setting, it tastes even better. Head to the second floor for the best photo backdrop.
places.editorialSummary: A vintage time capsule that feels like stepping into 1970s Vietnam — antiques, nostalgia, and genuinely great traditional coffee at budget prices.
places.bestFor: Atmosphere seekers, Instagram photographers, traditional coffee lovers

places.name: Lu Coffee
places.address: 62 Lê Quang Đạo, Bắc Mỹ Phú

redditQuotes.text: The Coconut Coffee deserves its reputation as the house specialty. Thick Vietnamese coffee meets frozen coconut cream to create a balanced, sweet treat.
redditQuotes.source: — The Way to Coffee · Da Nang Specialty Guide

places.verdict: A cozy neighborhood cafe where the owner Phú serves the best coconut coffee in Da Nang — and rents apartments upstairs for the ultimate coffee-adjacent living.

comparison.best for: Coconut coffee lovers and travelers wanting a local, neighborhood feel
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ · Famous coconut coffee · Cozy wooden furniture · Owner is warm and welcoming · Vietnamese bean focus
comparison.limitations: Small space · Not a specialty/third-wave shop
comparison.what to order: The Coconut Coffee — thick Vietnamese coffee meets frozen coconut cream. Balanced and sweet without overwhelming the coffee character.

places.whatToOrder: The Coconut Coffee — thick Vietnamese coffee meets frozen coconut cream. Balanced and sweet without overwhelming the coffee character.
places.editorialSummary: A cozy neighborhood cafe where the owner Phú serves the best coconut coffee in Da Nang — and rents apartments upstairs for the ultimate coffee-adjacent living.
places.bestFor: Coconut coffee lovers and travelers wanting a local, neighborhood feel

sourceMeta.guideTitle: 13 Best Coffee Shops in Da Nang

places.name: Puna Specialty Coffee & Eatery
places.address: 132 Lê Quang Đạo, Bắc Mỹ An

redditQuotes.text: Puna is special as it has the kind of charm to make you feel at home: rustic wooden interiors, terracotta floors, floral tablecloths. Many young people now go for Arabica.
redditQuotes.source: — Sprudge · The Sprudge Guide to Coffee in Da Nang

places.verdict: The total package — excellent in-house roasted coffee, all-day brunch, and a cozy atmosphere right in the tourist hub. Best for a slow morning.

comparison.best for: Brunch + coffee combos, people-watching, and take-home beans
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 1,117 reviews · In-house roasting · Ethiopian & Vietnamese blends · Great food menu
comparison.limitations: Can be busy with tourists · In the thick of the tourist strip
comparison.what to order: Their Ethiopian and Vietnamese specialty blend — a rich mix of chocolate, plum, and caramel. Pick up a bag of beans from the shelves for home. The pancakes and smoothie bowls are excellent too.

places.whatToOrder: Their Ethiopian and Vietnamese specialty blend — a rich mix of chocolate, plum, and caramel. Pick up a bag of beans from the shelves for home. The pancakes and smoothie bowls are excellent too.
places.editorialSummary: The total package — excellent in-house roasted coffee, all-day brunch, and a cozy atmosphere right in the tourist hub. Best for a slow morning.
places.bestFor: Brunch + coffee combos, people-watching, and take-home beans

places.name: Brewman Coffee Concept
places.address: K27a/21, Thái Phiên, Phước Ninh, Hải Châu

redditQuotes.text: Brewman Coffee Concept is a polished coffee shop in Danang. Sleek and modern-looking with a good selection of Vietnamese and international coffee.

places.verdict: Sleek, modern, and known for their deconstructed coconut coffee — the hipster way to enjoy a Vietnamese classic.

comparison.best for: Modern coffee aesthetics and the deconstructed coconut coffee experience
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · Sleek modern design · Vietnamese and international coffee · Deconstructed drinks
comparison.limitations: Can feel more "designed" than authentic · Located in an alley
comparison.what to order: The deconstructed coconut coffee — served as separate components so you can mix your own ratio. It's what made them famous.

places.name: Cà Phê Muối Huế
places.address: 114 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Bắc Mỹ Phú

redditQuotes.text: Try egg coffee, coconut coffee and salted coffee, those are a few specialties in Da Nang.
redditQuotes.source: — r/DaNang · Best Coffee Spot in Da Nang

redditQuotes.text: We enjoyed salt coffee so much that we got cups of matcha muối (salt matcha) to go. Salt matcha isn't too common so it's something you may want to try.

places.verdict: The essential salt coffee experience — cà phê muối was invented in Huế, and this is the best place to try it in Da Nang. Opens at 5 AM.

comparison.best for: Trying cà phê muối (salt coffee) — the Central Vietnamese specialty
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ · Budget-friendly (₫20k–₫50k) · Opens 5 AM · Salt coffee, salt cocoa, and salt matcha
comparison.limitations: More functional than atmospheric · Primarily one specialty
comparison.what to order: Cà phê muối (salt coffee) — whipped salt with fermented milk and cocoa powder over Vietnamese drip coffee. Also try the cà cao muối (salt cocoa) and, if you see it, muối matcha (salt matcha).

places.whatToOrder: Cà phê muối (salt coffee) — whipped salt with fermented milk and cocoa powder over Vietnamese drip coffee. Also try the cà cao muối (salt cocoa) and, if you see it, muối matcha (salt matcha).
places.editorialSummary: The essential salt coffee experience — cà phê muối was invented in Huế, and this is the best place to try it in Da Nang. Opens at 5 AM.
places.bestFor: Trying cà phê muối (salt coffee) — the Central Vietnamese specialty

places.name: WONDERLUST Coffee & Souvenir

redditQuotes.text: WONDERLUST Café is probably one of my favorite cafés in Da Nang, and it certainly left an impression. It's located in a 3-story building.
redditQuotes.source: — The Atlas Edit · The Serious Coffee Lover's Guide to Da Nang

places.verdict: A beautiful 3-story cafe with the full Da Nang experience — coffee, pastries, a souvenir shop, and genuine local charm under one roof.

comparison.best for: A leisurely morning with pastries, or buying Vietnamese coffee souvenirs
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 1,439 reviews · 3-story building · Bakery + coffee + souvenirs · Beautifully designed
comparison.limitations: Touristy · More about the full experience than pure coffee quality
comparison.what to order: Pair a Vietnamese drip coffee with their fresh pastries. Check out the souvenir shop for local coffee beans and handmade goods to take home.

places.name: Nối Café

redditQuotes.text: Noi Cafe is easily one of the most popular cafes in Da Nang. I went here twice and both times, it was packed with local customers.
One of the best places to try egg coffee in Da Nang is at Nối Café.
redditQuotes.source: — The Atlas Edit · Best Cafés in Da Nang

places.verdict: The most popular vintage cafe among young Vietnamese locals — packed every visit. Go for the egg coffee and the retro atmosphere.

comparison.best for: Egg coffee (cà phê trứng) in a vintage setting loved by locals
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ · Hugely popular with local Vietnamese youth · Vintage decor · Budget prices · Good egg coffee
comparison.limitations: Gets very crowded · Two locations across the street (the bigger one has more seating)
comparison.what to order: Cà phê trứng (egg coffee) — sweet, frothy whipped egg yolk with condensed milk over bold Vietnamese coffee. Like a tiramisu in a cup. Also good: avocado coffee.

places.whatToOrder: Cà phê trứng (egg coffee) — sweet, frothy whipped egg yolk with condensed milk over bold Vietnamese coffee. Like a tiramisu in a cup. Also good: avocado coffee.

places.name: Lighthouse Coffee
places.address: 12 Đ. Đình Nghệ, An Hải, Sơn Trà

redditQuotes.text: Lighthouse occupies an eye-catching brick structure. The roasting equipment sits in plain sight, used for Vietnamese beans that share the menu with selections from Campos in Australia.
redditQuotes.source: — The Way to Coffee · Da Nang Specialty Guide

places.verdict: A serious in-house roaster in a stunning brick building — Vietnamese beans alongside Australian imports (Campos), with the roasting equipment in full view.

comparison.best for: Watching beans being roasted and comparing Vietnamese vs. international origins
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 1,387 reviews · Eye-catching brick architecture · In-house roasting · Vietnamese + Campos beans
comparison.limitations: Across the river from the main beach area · More workspace than cafe vibe
comparison.what to order: Ask to compare their Vietnamese roast against the Campos Australian beans — it's a fascinating contrast that shows how far Vietnamese specialty has come.

places.whatToOrder: Ask to compare their Vietnamese roast against the Campos Australian beans — it's a fascinating contrast that shows how far Vietnamese specialty has come.

places.name: Dng.coffee

places.verdict: The go-to laptop cafe for Da Nang's massive digital nomad community — industrial design, fast wifi, Slayer espresso, and a productive atmosphere.

comparison.what to order: Colombian espresso — delivers reliable chocolate and caramel notes. Quick service for those squeezing coffee between video calls.
